name: Quotes
tagline: Turn a job enquiry into a priced quote the same day

roadmap.note: Shipped. Quotes, revisions and simple invoices - bookkeeping, tax accounting and reconciliation stay in your accounting software.

marketing.summary: A job enquiry comes in through the assistant. You open it, pick line items from your price list, and send a quote the customer can open on their phone and accept. No accounting software, no PDF wrangling.
marketing.audience: Trades and service businesses that quote per job: electricians, plumbers, builders, landscapers, mobile mechanics, cleaners.

features.title: Starts from the enquiry
features.body: The job details a customer gave the assistant are already in the request. You are pricing, not re-typing.

features.title: Your price list, reused
features.body: Saved line items with rates and units, so the second quote for the same kind of job takes under a minute.

features.title: Accepted with one tap
features.body: The customer opens a link, sees the quote, and accepts. You get told immediately and the quote is locked.

features.title: Revise without rewriting history
features.body: A revision is a fresh quote with a new number. What the customer already accepted, declined or let lapse stays exactly as it was.

features.title: Invoice the moment they accept
features.body: One click turns an accepted quote into a numbered invoice with the same agreed lines, a due date, your payment details and a printable page in your choice of theme.

faq.q: Does this replace my accounting software?
faq.a: No. Quotes and simple invoices live here; bookkeeping, tax accounting and reconciliation belong in Xero, MYOB or QuickBooks. An invoice here is a document your customer can read, print and pay against - not a ledger entry.

faq.q: Can I send an invoice from it?
faq.a: Yes - from an accepted quote. The lines and totals are copied exactly as agreed, the invoice gets its own INV number, and the customer gets a printable page. Mark it paid when the money lands; a paid invoice never changes.

faq.q: Can the customer pay a deposit when they accept?
faq.a: Not yet, for the same reason: paying money into your account needs a payment setup we have not built. The quote records the acceptance; you invoice from it and collect however you do today.
